pcs.pc_description: perform sanitization and gowning procedures as per SOP and clean room guidelines
wear personal protective equipment(PPE) before entering into the production area
prepare the gelatin solution/ dipping solution in jacketed pressure vessels as per batch manufacturing record (BMR)
perform dip-coating process as per BMR
perform drying of gelatin coated pins to achieve the target moisture content
perform stripping and trimming of capsule shells to achieve proper length as per BMR
perform joining of capsule shells
operate automatic capsule printing machine to print capsule shells as per BM
store the hard gelatin capsule shells in a container with lid, lined with double poly-bag
minimize waste/ rejections during entire production operation
perform total range of in-process checks specified to be performed as per SOP
use appropriate measuring instruments, equipment, tools, accessories etc. as required for carrying out in-process checks
confirm that the intermediate/final product meet the specifications
carry out status labelling and segregation of material/ intermediate / finished goods as per SOPs
segregate waste and perform disposal under supervision
provide support for line clearance before the next batch is produced
handover the work/ equipment to colleague in next shift in adherence with the shift schedule

pcs.pc_description: perform sanitization and gowning procedures as per clean room guidelines

use appropriate measuring instruments, equipment, tools, accessories etc. as required for carrying out in-process checks
confirm that the intermediate/final product meet the specifications

carry out status labelling and segregation of material/ intermediate / finished goods as per SOPs

provide support for line clearance before the next batch is produced
handover the work/ equipment to colleague in next shift in adherence with the shift schedule

pcs.pc_description: perform sanitization and gowning procedures as per SOP and cleanroom guidelines

monitor control variables like pore size and filter integrity during filtration
minimize waste/ rejections during the entire production operation

pcs.pc_description: perform sanitization and gowning procedures as per SOP and cleanroom guidelines
wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) before entering into the production area
ensure availability of QA approved packaging material
record the environmental variables like temperature and humidity
set the strip packaging/ blister packaging machine variables as per batch manufacturing record (BMR)
set the overprinting matter received from production chemist, on the overprint unit
fill the QA approved tablets/ capsules in the filling line/ sorter with care to minimize material overflow/ wastage/ excess flash/ spill
operate strip packing/blister packing machine to start the primary packaging
operate filling and packaging line in the correct pattern as per the SOP
monitor the packaging line for empty pockets, pocket cut disintegrated tablet/ capsules during primary packaging operation
segregate the defective strips/ blisters in a labeled container
minimize waste/ rejections during entire packaging operation
perform a total range of in-process checks specified for strip/ blister packaging
use appropriate measuring instruments, equipment, tools for carrying out in-process checks
confirm that packaged tablet/ capsule strips/ blisters meet the specifications for packaging, storage conditions, and labeling
ensure QA and production chemist provides the line clearance
ensure pre-printed over packing material is available near the packaging belt
perform carton filling, leaflet insertion, and carton closing
perform weighing of each carton and segregate cartons with varying weight
perform shipper packing of every weighed and approved carton
ensure specimen on shipper is approved by authorized personnel
seal with approved BOPP tape, label, and weigh the shipper box
segregate batchwise packaged and sealed shippers on pallets for storage and transportation in the warehouse
segregate packaging waste and perform disposal under supervision
sort the approved good tablets/ capsules from the defective packing for repacking
provide support for line clearance before the next batch is processed for packaging
handover the work/ equipment to colleague in next shift in adherence of the shift schedule
